<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
It's my second session, and I have a new message from Brad. He's telling me that none of the times I proposed work for Elena and David. He has provided a list of times when Elena and David are both free, and he's asking me to check these times against Priya's and Marcus's calendars.

I will now go through Brad's proposed times one by one and check them against the calendars I have for Priya and Marcus.

Brad's proposed times:
- Mon Nov 16: 11:00, 11:30
- Tue Nov 17: 09:00, 09:30
- Wed Nov 18: 13:00, 13:30
- Thu Nov 19: 09:30, 14:30, 15:00, 15:30

Checking Priya's calendar:
- Mon 11:00-11:30: Travel (Busy)
- Mon 11:30-12:00: Contract review (Busy)
- Tue 09:00-09:30: Board prep (Busy)
- Tue 09:30-10:00: Partner lunch (Busy)
- Wed 13:00-13:30: Client call (Busy)
- Wed 13:30-14:00: Client dinner prep (Busy)
- Thu 09:30-10:00: Busy
- Thu 14:30-15:00: (Free)
- Thu 15:00-15:30: Client dinner prep (Busy)
- Thu 15:30-16:00: Vendor meeting (Busy)

It seems from Priya's calendar, only Thursday at 14:30 is a possibility. I need to check this against Marcus's calendar.

Checking Marcus's calendar:
- Thu 14:00-14:30: Client dinner prep (Busy)
- Thu 14:30-15:00: (Free)

It appears that Thursday at 2:30 PM is a valid slot for both Priya and Marcus. This means I have found a time that should work for all four partners.

My next steps will be to:
1.  Share this finding with Brad in the workspace.
2.  Book the meeting for Thursday at 2:30 PM.
3.  Ask Brad to send the confirmation email.

I will start by appending to the workspace.<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>

2. Create the booking in the system.
3. End my session.
